description: Five independent tensor group restorations against original and held even7 anchors
hypothesis: At least one of the five predeclared tensor groups recovers a positive portion of the held even7 model's 1207-byte public-fixture archive penalty when restored independently to its original signed values. The matched table will quantify archive recovery, probability divergence, whole-process costs and restored model/package components without selecting a successor.

interfaces_exposed: Predeclared tensor group restoration, exact native archives, probability divergence and measured component costs
